column1: # Every SF Symbol name in ios/ and the Material Symbols Rounded icon Android draws for it (X-AD38).
# Columns: SF Symbol, Material Symbols name ("-" where Android draws none; `name#n` the icon's nth outline alone; `a + b`
# and `a - b` b drawn over a or cut out of it, placed and sized as SF's inner glyph), fill (1 for SF's .fill variants),
# where iOS draws it, and how close the match is. A use is `File:line size weight`: the
# symbol's point size (text styles at the default size: caption2 11, caption 12, footnote 13, subheadline 15, callout
# 16, body and headline 17, title3 20, title2 22, title 28) and SF weight; `inherited` takes the surrounding font (body,
# regular unless noted), `menu`, `tab` and `toolbar` the system's (24 dp on Android), `phase` the widget's three phase
# sites (20 bold, 12 bold and the Live Activity's own), `mac` the Mac app only. `small` is `.imageScale(.small)`, and
# `hierarchical` `.symbolRenderingMode(.hierarchical)`: the filled icon's shape at the opacity SF gives that layer, with
# its holes filled at full over it.
# MaterialSymbols.swift reads this file: it fetches each icon at the weights and optical sizes its uses need and writes
# MaterialSymbolPaths.kt. Grade 0; weight is SF's (ultraLight 100 … bold 700, heavier 700); optical size is the
# nearest of 20, 24, 40 and 48 to the point size.
